connect.approving: Confirm the server in the dialog.
connect.waiting: Approve access in the Nextcloud tab that just opened ({host}). This updates by itself once you're done.
connect.expired: Your Nextcloud sign-in has expired or was revoked. Sign in again.
connect.intro: Connect your Nextcloud to attach files from it, send large files as links and save attachments to it.
settings.title: Nextcloud account
settings.privacy: The app password is kept on the webmail server, not in this plugin. Disconnecting deletes it here and revokes it in Nextcloud.
settings.migration: Used Nextcloud Attachments before? Sign in once here. The old app password isn't carried over.
firstrun.offer: Nextcloud is available. Connect your account in Settings > Plugins > Nextcloud.
error.auth: Your Nextcloud sign-in has expired or was revoked. Sign in again.
error.forbidden: Nextcloud doesn't allow this for your account.
error.share_forbidden: Nextcloud doesn't let you share this with a link. Ask your Nextcloud administrator.
error.not_found: That file or folder no longer exists in Nextcloud.
error.exists: There is already a file or folder with that name.
error.quota: Your Nextcloud storage is full. Free up some space and try again.
error.too_large: The file is too large to transfer.
error.locked: The file is locked in Nextcloud, probably because someone is editing it. Try again later.
error.rate_limited: Too many requests to Nextcloud. Wait a minute and try again.
error.timeout: Nextcloud didn't answer in time. Try again.
error.unreachable: Couldn't reach your Nextcloud server. Check the address or try again later.
error.blocked: The webmail isn't allowed to connect to this server. Ask your administrator.
error.maintenance: Nextcloud is in maintenance mode. Try again later.
error.server: Nextcloud ran into an error. Try again later.
error.wrong_server: Your administrator set a different Nextcloud server. Connect again.
error.wrong_server_host: Your administrator set Nextcloud to {host}. Connect to that server.
error.login_expired: The sign-in took too long. Start again.
error.bad_answer: Nextcloud sent an answer the plugin doesn't understand.
